criteria.requirement: Add treelib.integrity.validate_structure(tree) returning deterministic diagnostic dictionaries code/id/related. Inspect the actual current tree.identifier scope for root validity, index-vs-node identity, missing parent/child, missing backlinks, duplicate successors, child-parent mismatch, cycles and unreachable nodes. Healthy empty/single/shared-view trees report no findings; foreign tree contexts are not corruption. Use iterative traversal to handle deep chains beyond Python recursion limits. Do not mutate, auto-repair or claim validation of arbitrary business data. Report multiple independent faults without hiding them behind the first exception and keep old traversal behavior unchanged.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
